hooks.command: [ "$GSC_SESSION" = routine ] || exit 0; python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/gsc_guard.py"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $rc -eq 2 ] || echo "GSC guard: internal error rc=$rc - failing closed" >&2; exit 2

[ "$GSC_SESSION" = routine ] || exit 0; python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/gsc_guard_post.py"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "GSC guard post-check: internal error rc=$rc - nothing restored" >&2; exit 1
[ "$GSC_SESSION" = routine ] || exit 0; echo "GSC guard: settings changes are blocked in routine sessions" >&2; exit 2
